SELECT n.notice_id, n.title, n.content, n.admin_id, n.is_read, n.target_user_id, n.feedback_id, n.reply, DATE_FORMAT(n.created_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS created_time, u.username AS admin_name FROM notice n LEFT JOIN users u ON n.admin_id = u.user_id WHERE n.notice_id = #{noticeId} AND n.feedback_id IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT nr.notice_id) FROM notice_read nr JOIN notice n ON nr.notice_id = n.notice_id AND n.feedback_id IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notice WHERE feedback_id IS NULL AND notice_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT notice_id FROM notice_read)

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE(nr.read_time), '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(*) AS count, COUNT(*) AS read_count FROM notice_read nr WHERE nr.read_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND nr.notice_id IN (SELECT notice_id FROM notice WHERE feedback_id IS NULL) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(DATE(nr.read_time), '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date DESC

SELECT u.user_id, u.username, COUNT(n.notice_id) AS notice_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notice_read nr WHERE nr.notice_id IN ( SELECT n2.notice_id FROM notice n2 WHERE n2.admin_id = u.user_id AND n2.feedback_id IS NULL )) AS read_count FROM users u LEFT JOIN notice n ON u.user_id = n.admin_id AND n.feedback_id IS NULL WHERE u.role = 'admin' GROUP BY u.user_id, u.username

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT nr.notice_id) FROM notice_read nr JOIN notice n ON nr.notice_id = n.notice_id AND n.feedback_id IS NULL) AS read_count FROM notice WHERE feedback_id IS NULL

SELECT al.call_id, al.user_id, al.history_id, al.call_status, al.call_error, DATE_FORMAT(al.call_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS call_time, u.username, gh.generation_description FROM api_log al LEFT JOIN users u ON al.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN generation_history gh ON al.history_id = gh.history_id
WHERE al.call_time BETWEEN #{startDate} AND CONCAT(#{endDate}, ' 23:59:59')
